reasons.text: The legible label photo shows model MK04, a recalled model, so the model is confirmed.

The duplicate check found another claim (b485a67d-9572-566b-b49e-e10d406bca3f) sharing the same address. Under the policy, any shared address requires a flag, so this claim goes to review despite otherwise meeting the criteria.
